sourceEvent: World Robot Olympiad (WRO) Autonomous Robotics Challenge

competencies.name: Autonomous Mission Route Optimization

competencies.evidenceRequired: AST graph traversal and waypoint execution log in under 120 seconds.

competencies.name: Dynamic Ambient Light Sensor Calibration

competencies.evidenceRequired: Sensor calibration routine emitting normalized RGB values across 4 distinct field zones.
